players.product: On-site power generation for AI data centers and large loads (Liberty Power Innovations: multi-OEM engine generation stacks with BESS, energy management and ERCOT/PJM market participation)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: Liberty's top five customers collectively accounted for approximately 39%, 43% and 34% of revenues in 2025, 2024 and 2023. For 2025, Occidental Petroleum Corporation and XTO Energy Inc. accounted for more than 10% of consolidated revenues; for 2024 Occidental Petroleum Corporation accounted for more than 10%; in 2023 no customer exceeded 10%. The notes separately report unnamed customer A and customer C at 11% each of 2025 consolidated revenues.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers ~39% of 2025 revenues; Occidental Petroleum and XTO Energy each more than 10%

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: total revenue for 2025 was $4,006,116 thousand versus $4,315,161 thousand in 2024. Purchases of property and equipment, construction in-progress and deposits on equipment were $595,493 thousand in 2025, and investing cash flows included a $78.8 million increase in deposits on new equipment orders.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue $4,006,116 thousand (2024: $4,315,161 thousand); capex incl. deposits $595,493 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K supply: as a result of high demand and limited supply for certain inventory and equipment needed by its distributed power business, Liberty has entered and may continue to enter into long-term purchase commitments with vendors at prices and on terms less favorable to it, and competitors may obtain inventory and equipment from the same vendors. Liberty says it is not dependent on any single source of supply for the parts, components and materials of its hydraulic fracturing and distributed power operations.
